comparison.objective: Seat a platform on three kinematic datums, versus seat a collet in an eccentric retaining ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual level lowering onto cone, groove and flat contacts; candidate uses localized groove capture, tilt-roll insertion and snap engagement.
comparison.success_condition: All three datum contacts, pose tolerances, release and stability are required; candidate requires circumferential retention and withdrawal resistance. Candidate lacks quantitative pose/force thresholds.
comparison.reason: Both involve precision seating, but the kinematic-location ability differs from retained snap assembly.
